context: A boss reviews a customer notification process with his manager
purpose: Teach: 郵送/口頭/卸売/呼び出し/要旨/契機/有意義/増殖

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今回の顧客通知プロセスの見直し、要旨をまとめてくれたかな。
lines.en: Did you put together the summary of this customer notification process review?
lines.style: Authoritative boss opening, measured pace, businesslike with mild expectation undertone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、こちらの資料に整理しました。まず重要書類は郵送、軽微な連絡は口頭で対応しております。
lines.en: Yes, I organized it in this document. Important papers go by mail, minor matters are handled verbally.
lines.style: Diligent salaryman, polite keigo, slightly nervous but confident in his preparation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: なるほど。卸売業者への通知も同じ流れでいいのか？
lines.en: I see. Is the notification to wholesale vendors handled the same way?
lines.style: Probing follow-up question, calm but pointed, testing employee's thoroughness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 卸売の取引先には専用窓口を設けまして、緊急時は担当者の内線に呼び出しがかかる仕組みです。
lines.en: For wholesale partners, we set up a dedicated contact desk, so urgent matters page the rep's extension directly.
lines.style: Detailed explanatory tone, structured business Japanese, eager to demonstrate competence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ほう、それは良いな。先月のクレームを契機に改善したわけか。
lines.en: Hmm, that's good. So you improved it triggered by last month's complaint, I take it.
lines.style: Pleasantly impressed, slower rhythm, showing genuine recognition of subordinate's work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: その通りです。問い合わせが社内で増殖していた感がありましたので、根本から見直しました。
lines.en: Exactly. There was a sense that inquiries were multiplying internally, so we reviewed it fundamentally.
lines.style: Reflective and earnest, slight self-criticism, professional acknowledgment of past issues.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今日の打ち合わせは実に有意義だった。来週の役員会でこの内容を共有しよう。
lines.en: Today's meeting was truly meaningful. Let's share this content at next week's executive meeting.
lines.style: Warm closing remark, approving and decisive, satisfied boss wrapping up productively.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。役員会の資料も、明日までに準備いたします。
lines.en: Thank you very much. I'll prepare the materials for the executive meeting by tomorrow.
lines.style: Grateful and respectful closing, motivated tone, eager subordinate accepting new task.
